KShs. 5B
Capital injection from KCB to strengthen
NBK’s balance sheet and shore up it’s
capital position.

1:10
The NBK acquisition was effected
through a share swap of one KCB
share for every ten NBK shares, which
resulted in the listing of 147.7 million
additional KCB shares at the Nairobi
Securities Exchange (NSE).
